args.body: generation 1: Name a real chassis: Cupriavidus necator, which fixes CO2 through the Calvin cycle with hydrogen as the electron donor. It is a bacterium that eats carbon in the first sense and it is already used industrially. Scientific names did not resolve before this run either -- the refusal above advised using one while the reader could not read one -- so this also tests the fix.
